html:
The Tu Lan Cave Tour 1 Day is a thrilling adventure in Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park, designed for travelers seeking a mix of trekking, swimming, and cave exploration. Explore Hang Chuot (Rat Cave), the dramatic Hung Ton Cave, and the picturesque To Mo Valley, finishing with a delicious BBQ beside a waterfall.

This tour is perfect for those who want a full-day adventure in the Tu Lan cave system. For a longer experience, consider the Tu Lan Cave Encounter (2 Days) or Wild Tu Lan Cave Explorer (3 Days).

This tour is suitable for physically active travelers aged 16 and above.

ITINERARY

Phong Nha – Tan Hoa – To Mo – Tan Hoa – Phong Nha

07:00 – 07:30 – Pick up from your hotel/guesthouse in Phong Nha. Drive 70 km over the Da Deo Mountain Pass to reach Tan Hoa ethnic minority village and Oxalis Headquarters. Store extra luggage at the office.

08:00 – Safety briefing, gear check, and sign the Release Form.

08:30 – Trek 2 km across peanut and buffalo fields to reach the Rao Nan River.

09:00 – Cross the river and explore Hang Chuot (Rat Cave), discovering its massive formations for up to 280 meters.

10:30 – Trek through Hung Ton Valley to Hung Ton Cave. Descend a 15 m ladder with a safety rope, swim 50 m through the cave, and follow an underground river to To Mo Valley.

12:30 – Enjoy a BBQ lunch beside a scenic waterfall and optional swimming.

13:30 – 16:00 – Trek over Hung Ton Mountain (1 km), across Hung Ton Valley (500 m), and a small hill to return to Rao Nan River (500 m). Cross back over peanut and buffalo fields (2.5 km) to Oxalis Headquarters. Refresh with a cold drink and shower.

17:00 – 18:30 – Drive back to Phong Nha and drop off at your hotel/guesthouse.

TOUR INFORMATION

  • Operating Period: November – September (closed in October)

  • Duration: 1 day

  • Adventure Level: Easy/Moderate, 8 km (swimming required)

  • Group Size: 2 – 8 pax (small-group tour)

  • Minimum Age: 16 years old

  • Start Time: 07:00 – 07:30 from any hotel in Phong Nha

  • End Time: 18:00 – 18:30 at any hotel in Phong Nha

  • Price: 90 USD per person

INCLUSIONS

  • Private car transfers

  • Trekking equipment

  • BBQ lunch

  • English-speaking local guide

  • Bottled water

EXCLUSIONS

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips

CHILD POLICY

  • Only travelers aged 16 years and above can join this tour
